create.name: Martin Aylward
create.bio:
Martin Aylward is a Dharma teacher who has made his home in south-west France since 1995. He set off for India at nineteen and passed most of the next four years practising in monasteries and ashrams across Asia, training in Vipassana, staying at Wat Suan Mokkh with Ajahn Buddhadasa and living for two years with a Hindu sadhu near Dharamsala. He later sat yearly month-long retreats in Bodh Gaya with Christopher Titmuss, who encouraged him to teach, and he has also practised Mahamudra and Dzogchen and spent thirteen years in the Diamond Approach. He has taught since 1999.

With his wife Gail he founded Moulin de Chaves, a residential retreat centre near Périgueux in the Dordogne, where they live and lead most of his retreats in English and French. His teaching joins silent insight meditation with close attention to the body and to ordinary life, including work, money and relationships. He also founded the online community Sangha Live, co-directs the Mindfulness Training Institute's year-long teacher trainings in Europe and the United States, and has led walking pilgrimages through France. His book Awake Where You Are: The Art of Embodied Awareness appeared in 2021.

books.title: Awake Where You Are: The Art of Embodied Awareness
books.author: Martin Aylward
books.description: Martin's guide to meditation grounded in the body, published by Wisdom in 2021. It moves through sensation, desire, emotion and love, joining Buddhist practice with insights from psychology, and offers exercises along the way.

courses.title: Forming the Formless: A 5-day retreat of contemplative and creative practice
courses.description: A residential retreat at Moulin de Chaves co-led with the artist Sam Winston, pairing meditation with simple writing, drawing and time outdoors. No artistic or meditation experience is needed. Booking opens in January 2027.
courses.price: Teaching fee €445 EUR (subsidised €385 EUR), plus accommodation from €360 EUR

courses.title: BREADTH AND DEPTH: A 13 day retreat for experienced practitioners
courses.description: Martin's yearly two-week retreat for people who have already sat silent retreats. Ten days of sustained silent practice with personal interviews are followed by three days that add dialogue and relational practice, all centred on teachings about the nature of mind.
courses.price: Teaching by dana; accommodation from €850 EUR

courses.title: Presence, Love and Clarity: Liberating the Three Centres
courses.description: A week-long, mostly silent retreat at Moulin de Chaves led by Martin and Gail Aylward, working through meditation, movement and inquiry with the body, heart and mind as three centres of awareness. Includes time to meet the teachers.
courses.price: Teaching fee €200 EUR plus dana; accommodation from €430 EUR

courses.title: Earth Below and Sky Above: A Meditation and Qigong Retreat
courses.description: A residential week in which Martin teaches meditation and Dharma while Mimi Kuo-Deemer leads qigong movement. Days combine silent and guided sitting, slow movement, talks and discussion, and suit beginners as well as experienced students.
courses.price: Teaching fee €445 EUR (subsidised €385 EUR), plus accommodation from €430 EUR

courses.title: Breath and Death: A profound practice guide to Anapanasati (Awareness of Breathing) – a 5-day retreat
courses.description: Recordings of a five-day online retreat, fifteen sessions and over twenty hours, in which Martin works through all sixteen steps of the Buddha's teaching on mindfulness of breathing.

courses.title: Contemplating Death to Liberate Your Life with Martin Aylward (a 3-hour class)
courses.description: A recorded three-hour class, first given for New York Insight, on reflecting on death as a Buddhist practice that brings fresh attention to how we live.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations Download
free_resources.description: A free set of five guided meditations with short teachings from Martin on the spacious quality of the mind, available to download after signing up to his mailing list.

free_resources.title: The 3 Jewels meditation
free_resources.description: A free thirty-minute guided meditation on the Buddha, Dharma and Sangha, sent by email when you join his newsletter.

flags: Gaia House lists him as a visiting teacher but is not a Spiritpedia listing yet, so teaches_at is empty; his own calendar shows a 'Silent retreat, Gaia House' in late 2027 with no dates or page yet.

Base: his about page says he lives at Moulin de Chaves in south-west France; the centre's contact page puts it at Cubjac (Dordogne), about 20 km from Périgueux. City set to Cubjac; Périgueux may geocode better.

Tier: Instagram and Facebook counts unreadable (robots.txt). He founded Moulin de Chaves and Sangha Live, co-leads the Mindfulness Training Institute (which says it has over 300 certified teachers) and has a TEDx talk; the owner may consider an editorial-stature or student-count override. None applied.

Possible overlap with existing listings: Mark Coleman (co-leads the MTI teacher training with him) and Mimi Kuo-Deemer (co-leads the August 2027 qigong retreat). Gail Aylward, his wife and co-teacher, is mentioned only in the bio.
Email: info@martinaylward.com appears only inside a script setting on the page, not as published text, so the contact form is used instead.

Books: amazon.com not opened (its robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot). The ISBN-10 1614297223 is the US Wisdom paperback (ISBN-13 978-1-61429-722-2 printed on the cover in his own photo, and listed on Open Library).
Photo: only the YouTube avatar used; site images are mostly group, archive or book-cover shots.
left_out: EU Certified Mindfulness Teacher Training 2026-2027 (with Mark Coleman): started September 2026; later modules are for the enrolled group only.
Voyage au Cambodge pilgrimage (16-27 Nov 2026): run by a travel agency (Oasis Voyages) and in French; left out.

French-language retreats (Éveiller la nature du Bouddha, Une Vie Plus Vaste, Aller au-delà) and the Terre d'Eveil weekend in Paris: kept to the English programmes; Aller au-delà and Une Vie Plus Vaste are 2028.
Sangha Live courses (I See You Mara!, Wide Open and Free, The Power of Not Knowing) and the Sangha Live Days of Practice: hosted on Sangha Live's platform with no price shown on the course pages.
French books Tout le monde peut méditer and Le corps au coeur de la méditation: no amazon.com listing confirmed; the first is sold partly on coping with stress.
YouTube: 'Mindfulness teacher training' promo (2:10), 'Freedom with Flowing' and the third-party interviews (Alex Howard, Jacob Burda, Southsea Sangha) not chosen.
